title: Some think God fixes the broken.
paragraphs:
Some think God fixes the broken.
Sometimes, He just breathes, and they start building.

Ezekiel 37:5–6
“This is what the Sovereign Lord says to these bones: I will make breath enter you, and you will come to life. I will attach tendons to you and make flesh come upon you and cover you with skin; I will put breath in you, and you will come to life.”
→ God’s breath revives what is dead — rebuilding life from ruin. A direct image of divine reconstruction.
